author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
For all the mods who sit there waiting for a person spamming who was reported for spam the developers could create this plugin. Chat Log shows what the player has said earlier. For example /cl Sethskye 1
9/21/14 3:34 pm Sethskye: Gg
9/21/14 3:20 pm Sethskye: spam
9/21/14 3:20 pm Sethskye: Spam
9/21/14 3:20 pm Sethskye: Spam
9/21/14 3:20 pm Sethskye: Spam
9/21/14 3:20 pm Sethskye: Spam
9/21/14 3:20 pm Sethskye: Spam
9/21/14 3:20 pm Sethskye: Spam
9/21/14 3:20 pm Sethskye: Spam
9/21/14 3:20 pm Sethskye: Spam

this goes up to a max of 10 lines but there are multiple pages
/cl Sethskye 2/3/4/5(Max 5 Pages)
the 2 indicates the 2nd page. 
The Chatlog resets every 12 hours

Any other thoughts?

Thanks Steven for these ideas:
Also you should type /cl Sethskye,steven5703 1
Which would show both mine and seth's logs.

eg:
9/21/14 3:34 pm Sethskye: Gg
9/21/14 3:20 pm steven5703: i hate u sethskye sux dix!!11!!!!one!
9/21/14 3:20 pm Sethskye: stfu scrub

It should also record teamchat.
9/21/14 3:20 pm Sethskye: Gg
8/12/14 3:20 pm steven5703: i hate u sethskye sux dix!!11!!!!one!
9/21/14 3:20 pm [T] Sethskye: I really hate steven
